# Expand context: file-lines endpoints and "expand hidden lines" bars ## What to build The diff viewer gets GitHub-style **context expansion**: - Between two hunks, and above the first or below the last hunk of a file, it shows a bar: `↕ 37 hidden lines`. - The bar has **expand up** (20 lines), **expand down** (20 lines) and, when ≤ 60 lines are hidden, **expand all**. - Expanded lines render as context rows with correct old and new line numbers, the data attributes, and highlighting. - When a gap closes, the two hunks merge into one block. The lines come from new read-only endpoints on both servers: - run page: `GET /file?node=&path=

&from=&to=`, or `GET /file?round=&path=

&from=&to=` for the human-review diff - suite page: `GET /api/file?node=&path=&from=&to=` and `GET /api/file?round=&path=&from=&to=` Response: ```json { "path": "src/api/users.ts", "from": 40, "to": 59, "lines": ["…"], "total": 212 } ``` - `from`/`to` are 1-based and inclusive on the **new** side, clamped to `total`, with at most 500 lines per call. - 404 for an unknown node, round or path; 400 for a path that is not in that node's or round's changed files, or for bad numbers; 415 for a binary file. The previous slices delivered: - `src/web/assets/diff.js`: `parseFileDiff`, and the unified/split renderers with data attributes - `src/web/assets/diffview.js`: `mountDiffView(container, {files, loadDiff, onLine, mode})`, the file tree, highlight.js via `highlightLines(hljs, text, lang)` and `langOf(path)` - the right panel (`panel.js`) ## Context: files to read before implementing - `src/runner/changes.ts`: - L10–44: `FileDiff`, `capDiff`, and `worktreeFileDiff(worktree, base, file)`, which reads untracked files from the worktree - L46–104: `Tracked` `{worktree, base, running, range?: {repo, to}}` and `ChangeTracker.fileDiff(nodeId, file)`. It uses `rangeFileDiff(repo, base, to, file)` when `range` is set, else the worktree. - L84–87: `tracked(nodeId)` returns `{worktree, base, running}` but **not** `range` - `src/web/server.ts`: - L55–71: `WebServerOptions.changes` is typed `Pick` - L353–363: `changesRoute`, which validates the node with `graphModel(...).nodes.get(id)` and the file against `node.view.changes?.files` - L183–196: `/review/diff` (round validation: `loadHumanRound(human.runDir, round)`, the file must be in `rangeChanges(repo, diffBase, diffHead)`) - L365–415: `handle()`, its prefix dispatch, and the `known` list at L413 - `src/web/start.ts` L28–29: how `changes` and `human` are passed in. - `src/suite/server.ts`: - L315–329: `/api/changes?node=&file=`. `suiteChangeSources` (`src/suite/changes.ts` L15–17, L46) gives `{kind:"range",repo,from,to,only?} | {kind:"live",worktree,base,only?}`. - L155–165: `/api/review/diff` - L281–284: `allowedMethod`, where `/api/file` must be added as GET - `src/git/git.ts`: `gitRead` and `rangeFileDiff` (L306–308). Use `git show :` to read a file at a commit. - `src/web/server.test.ts`: - L346–385: `/changes` tests with a stub `changes` - L387–418: `setupComments()` (a real temp repo plus `startHumanRound`) - `src/suite/server.test.ts` L182–224: `reviewSetup()`. ## Patterns to follow **Reading a file's lines** (add to `src/runner/changes.ts`): ```ts /** Lines [from, to] (1-based, inclusive) of `file` at the node's head: the range's `to` commit, or the worktree file. */ async fileLines(nodeId: string, file: string, from: number, to: number): Promise<{ lines: string[]; total: number } | "binary" | undefined> ``` - range: `git show ${to}:${file}` - worktree: `readFile(path.join(worktree, file))` - binary when there is a NUL byte in the first 8000 bytes, the same rule as `worktreeFileDiff` - split on `\n`, and drop the final empty element Widen `WebServerOptions.changes` to `Pick`. For the review round, add an exported `finalFileLines(repo, ref, file, from, to)` in `src/web/server.ts` next to `finalFileDiff`, using `diffHead` as the ref. **Pure context merge** (in `diffview.js`): ```js /** Gaps around hunks: [{beforeHunk:i, from, to}] in new-side numbers; the last gap uses `total` once known. */ export function gaps(hunks, total) {} /** Inserts fetched lines (new-side from..to) as ctx lines, with old numbers shifted by the hunk offset, merging hunks whose gap closed. */ export function expand(hunks, from, lines) {} ``` The old-side number of an expanded context line is the new-side number plus the offset of the neighbouring hunk: `oldStart - newStart` of the hunk below, or of the hunk above when expanding below the last hunk. ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `src/runner/changes.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `fileLines` on `ChangeTracker`. - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/runner`. Add a test in the existing changes test file, if there is one (`ls src/runner/*changes*`), using a real temp repo from `src/__fixtures__/repo.js` `tempRepo`. ### UPDATE `src/web/server.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: a `"GET /file"` route. - Validate the query: `path` required; `from`/`to` positive integers with `to >= from`, and `to - from < 500` after clamping. - With `node`: the same node and file validation as `changesRoute`, then `changes.fileLines`. - With `round`: the same validation as `/review/diff`, then `finalFileLines`. - Respond as specified, and register the route in `routes` so the 404/405 fallback knows it. - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/server` ### UPDATE `src/suite/server.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `GET /api/file`. For `node`, resolve the change source as `/api/changes` does: a range source reads `git show to:path`, and a live source reads the worktree file. For `round`, use `finalFileLines` with the suite review round's `diffHead`. Add the route to `allowedMethod`. - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/suite/server` ### UPDATE `src/web/assets/diffview.js` and `diffview.css` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `gaps`, `expand` - the expand bars (`.expand` row with `↑`, `↓` and `↕ all` buttons and the hidden count) - `mountDiffView` takes a `loadLines(path, from, to)` option; a bar is shown only when it is given - the bar below the last hunk needs `total`, so it fetches the first 20 lines lazily, or shows "expand down" until the response says the end was reached - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets` ### UPDATE `src/web/page.html` and `src/suite/page.html` - **IMPLEMENT**: pass `loadLines` to `mountDiffView`, for node diffs (`?node=`) and for the review diff (`?round=`). - **VALIDATE**: build, then agent-browser: in a node diff with two hunks, click expand twice and see the lines appear; expand all until the hunks merge. ### UPDATE tests - `src/web/assets/diffview.test.ts`: `gaps` (first hunk at line 1 → no top gap; between hunks; `total` known); `expand` (partial up, partial down, closing a gap merges, old numbers correct). - `src/web/server.test.ts`: - `/file?round=1&path=a.txt&from=1&to=2` → `["one","two"]` with total 3, using the `setupComments` repo where a.txt goes from `one\ntwo` to `one\ntwo\nthree` - a bad path → 400; an unknown round → 400/404; not waiting → 409; `from > to` → 400 - `src/suite/server.test.ts`: `/api/file?round=1&...` → 200. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `GET /file` and `GET /api/file` return `{path, from, to, lines, total}` for node and review-round diffs, with the 400/404/409/415 errors above and at most 500 lines per call - [ ] Only files in the node's or round's change list can be read, and paths never escape the repo - [ ] Expand bars show the hidden counts and reveal 20 lines per click, up or down, plus "all" when ≤ 60 lines are hidden - [ ] Expanded lines have correct old and new numbers, highlighting and data attributes, and hunks merge when the gap closes - [ ] Works in unified and split mode on both pages - [ ] `npm test` passes, and an agent-browser before/after screenshot of an expansion is in the report ## Validation commands ```bash npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint . npx vitest run src/web src/suite/server src/runner npm run build ```
